description: Nozomi's special events: all of SERIFU/EVENT_KY.BIN (entries 49-53, most in a softer and a tomboyish version by mood: carrying books, the broken exhibit, the thunderstorm swim, cyclamens, the dodgeball). See docs/game-internals.md 6z.

あっ、あれは{G}。
重そうな本を抱えてるけど、
軽々と運んでるなぁ。
lines.text:
There's {G}.
Those books look heavy,
but she lifts them easily.

{G}。

{P}

いや、いい。

そ、そう？
